selected_script.angle: Struggling with cleaning under heavy laundry units and floor scratches
selected_script.hook: Still trying to drag your washing machine by hand and ruining your floors?

usage_steps_used: Loosen the fixing screw at the center of the stand
Pull the metal frame to adjust length to match appliance base
Tighten the fixing screw to lock length in place
Place the two stands parallel under each side of the appliance base
Press down the brake pads at the ends to fix stands in place

timeline.visual: A person struggling and straining their back while trying to drag a heavy washing machine across a hardwood floor, leaving a visible scratch mark on the wood.
timeline.audio: Still straining your back and scratching up your floors just to move heavy appliances?

timeline.visual: Introduce the silver-white telescopic dolly. A hand loosens the center joint fixing screw, pulls the metal frame horizontally to adjust it, and tightens the center screw.
timeline.audio: Check out this adjustable heavy duty moving dolly pack.

timeline.visual: Place the two dolly stands parallel under each side of the washing machine's base.
timeline.audio: Just adjust the length, lock it, and slide them parallel under the base.

timeline.visual: Close-up of a foot pressing down the front brake levers at the ends of both dolly stands, locking them firmly in place.
timeline.audio: Press down the brakes to secure them firmly before operating.

timeline.visual: The washing machine sits stable and vibration-free during operation, then rolls out effortlessly when the brakes are unlocked.
timeline.audio: It prevents shifting while operating and rolls effortlessly when you need to clean.

timeline.visual: Text overlay: 'Keep your floors safe and appliances mobile.' Show the product parked neatly.
timeline.audio: Protect your floors and make moving easy today.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Aspect ratio 9:16. Realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Pain Conflict. Close-up of a person straining and struggling to pull a heavy white washing machine across a light wooden floor, showing a fresh scratch mark on the floor. 3-6s: Product Solution. Introducing a pair of Silver-White and Black metal telescopic dolly stands. A hand loosens the center joint fixing screw, pulls the frame horizontally to adjust the length, and tightens the screw. 6-10s: Fast-cut Scene 1. Show the two dolly stands placed parallel under the left and right sides of the washing machine base. Product identity: silver-white metal frame, black anti-slip top pads, front-facing black brake levers, low-profile rollers. Keep consistent home laundry room setting. No CTA.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Aspect ratio 9:16. Continuation of part 1. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut Scene 2. A foot presses down firmly on the front-facing black brake levers of both dolly stands under the washing machine to lock them in place. 4-8s: Fast-cut Scene 3. The washing machine is operating stably, then the brakes are unlocked and it is rolled out effortlessly, exposing clean space behind. 8-10s: Light CTA. The washing machine is rolled back and locked. Text overlay: 'Protect your floors and make moving easy today!' Maintain identical product identity: silver-white heavy-gauge steel frame, black anti-slip rubber pads, front black brake levers, low-profile twin rollers.
